name: Pascal
description:
I am doing research on Ethereum protocol-level economics and incentive design. Currently, I mainly working on APS (esp. Execution Tickets) and multi-block MEV. Previous work included data analysis on blobs and the effects of EIP-4844 on Layer 2s.
In my former life I co-founded the fintech company CARL, being responsible for tech, product and operations. We scaled the company to more than 40 people becoming the leading M&A SME market place in Europe.
